title: strategic-account-orchestration-grid
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet translates multiple signals into an actionable orchestration grid for QBR and renewal prioritization. Designed for CS Managers and AMs to quickly classify accounts, surface operational risks, and pick a playbook (light-touch / expansion / retention / strategic) along with cadence and owner.

High-level approach (one-sentence):
Score accounts across five orthogonal dimensions (Monetary, ICP Fit, Product Intensity, Deployment Mode Risk, Region + Compliance) then map to priority buckets that drive QBR cadence and a short playbook.

Scoring dimensions and scoring rubric (0-5 each):
- ARR / Strategic Value (Monetary): 0 none, 1 <$10k, 2 $10k-50k, 3 $50k-200k, 4 $200k-1M, 5 >$1M or strategic reference account.
- ICP Fit: 0 no fit, 1 weak, 2 moderate, 3 good, 4 strong, 5 exemplar (reference / case study potential).
- Product Intensity (usage breadth/depth): 0 trial, 1 single feature low use, 2 single feature steady, 3 multi-feature, 4 high-token volume / realtime, 5 mission-critical with SLOs.
- Deployment Mode Risk (hosted/dedicated/private): 0 low-risk hosted, 1 hosted with customizations, 2 occasional Dedicated, 3 Dedicated with custom infra, 4 Private/VPC w/ compliance, 5 Air-gapped / on-prem requiring engineering support. Higher value = higher orchestration effort and renewal fragility.
- Region & Compliance Complexity: 0 NA, 1 low EMEA, 2 multiple regions low-complexity, 3 APAC with localization, 4 region-specific compliance (e.g., GDPR + local data residency), 5 heavy regulated (financial, healthcare) or multi-jurisdictional legal concerns.

Derived signals (binary/auxiliary):
- Churn Indicators: billing disputes, exec org changes, support SLA spikes, product regressions called out in tickets.
- Expansion Signals: new product trials, sandbox creation, seats growth >20% QoQ, new internal champions.
- Health signals: latency/error trends, eval regression alerts, model quality complaints.
- Contract timing: months to renewal (MTR).

Scoring workflow (how to use the sheet):
1) Populate base fields for the account: ARR, deployment_type, primary_region, next_renewal_date, primary_contact, CS_owner.
2) Rate the five dimensions using available data (billing, telemetry, infra notes, legal). If uncertain, mark as "needs validation" and attach a pointer (ticket or PR).
3) Add derived signals as tags (churn_risk, expansion_opportunity, technical_sla_issue).
4) System computes Total Score = sum(dimensions) (0-25). Use total + MTR to bucket priority.

Priority buckets (mapping):
- Strategic (Total 20-25 or ARR>500k and ICP Fit>=4): Weekly stakeholder cadence, cross-functional renewal squad, exec briefing, dedicated SRE/SE resource. Playbook: Strategic-Account Playbook.
- Growth (Total 14-19 or ARR 100k-500k with expansion signals): Biweekly QBR + adoption-focused playbook; trial expansion packages, ROI/usage workshops. Playbook: Growth-Expansion Pack.
- Maintenance (Total 8-13): Monthly QBR or quarterly depending on MTR; health checks, automated nudges. Playbook: Standard Renew & Retain.
- Low-touch (Total 0-7): Quarterly business reviews or as-needed; low-cost automation (emails, onboarding docs). Playbook: Low-touch Nurture.
- At-risk (any account with churn indicators regardless of score OR MTR <3 months and sudden negative signals): Immediate outreach, escalation to retention ops, possibly offer concessions. Playbook: Retention Rapid Response.

Example scored accounts (illustrative):
- Nimbus Health (example): ARR $720k -> ARR score 4, ICP Fit 5, Product Intensity 5, Deployment Mode 4 (Private VPC), Region 4 (EU+US legal), Total = 22 -> Strategic. Action: schedule exec briefing, assign SE, open renewal negotiation 120 days out.
- AlphaApps: ARR $60k -> ARR 3, ICP Fit 3, Product Intensity 2, Deployment Mode 0 (hosted), Region 1, Total = 9 -> Maintenance. Action: focus on usage nudges and 90-day ROI email sequence.
- ValleyTrial (pilot): ARR $2k -> ARR 1, ICP Fit 2, Product Intensity 0, Deployment Mode 0, Region 0, Total = 3 -> Low-touch. Action: automated onboarding and trial expiry playbook.

QBR agenda template (30-60 minutes depending on bucket):
- 5 min: Executive summary & objectives for this quarter
- 10 min: Adoption + usage highlights (top 3 metrics)
- 10 min: Risk & incident review (latency, errors, regressions)
- 10 min: Opportunity map (features or products to expand)
- 5 min: Commercial & contract timeline (MTR, renewal asks)
- 5 min: Action items & owners

Renewal readiness tracker columns (recommended fields in sheet):
- account_name, account_id, cs_owner, am_owner, ARR_bucket, total_score, priority_bucket, primary_deployment, region_tags, next_renewal_date, months_to_renewal, churn_flags, expansion_flags, last_qbr_date, last_major_incident, se_assigned, legal_review_needed, playbook, recommended_cadence, next_action, notes_link

Operational playbook snippets (concise):
- Strategic-Account Playbook: 1) Form cross-functional squad (CS, AM, SE, SRE, Legal). 2) Weekly internal sync + monthly exec QBR. 3) Technical health baseline + dedicated SLO targets. 4) Renewal negotiation timeline with commercial milestones.
- Growth-Expansion Pack: 1) Run 2x ROI workshops tailored to a use case. 2) Offer limited trial seats to adjacent teams. 3) Provide quarterly joint roadmap session with product.
- Retention Rapid Response: 1) Immediate 48-hour triage call. 2) Temporary concessions checklist. 3) Post-mortem and action plan with clear owners within 7 days.

Decision heuristics & tie-breakers: 
- If two accounts have same total score, prefer the one with closer MTR.
- If tech risk high (deployment mode >=3) but ARR low, escalate to Solutions Engineering for an operational feasibility note before renewing.
- Mark accounts with legal_review_needed if Region score >=4 or deployment_mode >=4.

Notes on data fidelity and governance:
- This sheet is a working artifact; every account should have at least one data pointer (billing invoice, telemetry dashboard link, or legal ticket) for dimension justifications.
- If a dimension is "needs validation", default to conservative bucket for renewal outreach planning.

Next steps for adoption (owners & timeline):
- Pilot phase (Owners: Jordan Patel + Maya Chen): run on top 25 accounts for EMEA by 2026-03-01.
- Feedback loop: collect AM and SE input after each QBR and update scoring weights monthly.
- Automation: feed the most objective dimensions (ARR, months-to-renewal, deployment_type, region) from CRM and infra tags into the sheet by 2026-04-15.

Open questions / discussion topics (to resolve in pilot):
- Should we weight Deployment Mode higher for accounts with strong expansion signals?
- Standardize what counts as "Product Intensity" across token-based and seat-based customers.
- Which concessions are pre-approved for Retention Rapid Response (Discount caps, free months, SE time allocation).

Attachments / bookmarks for the account row (recommend storing links in the notes_link column):
- telemetry dashboard link, recent support incident IDs, contract summary (SOW), legal redlines, previous QBR deck link.

Change log (short):
- 2025-10-07: initial draft by Jordan Patel.
- 2025-12-02: added Derived signals list and priority bucket definitions (Maya Chen).
- 2026-02-18: clarified deployment-mode escalation path and added pilot next steps (Luis Rodríguez).

End of document.
